subject: The one feature 90% of users skip (big mistake)
preview_text: I discovered something unsettling about how people use the scanner. You're probably making the same error.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing some anonymous data the other day, and a pattern jumped out at me. It was so obvious, and honestly, a little scary. Most people only use the scanner once, on one conversation, and think they have the full picture.

Here's the brutal truth: toxic people don't show all their red flags in one text. They drip-feed them. They're good on Tuesday, manipulative on Thursday, love-bombing by Sunday. Looking at one screenshot is like judging a movie by a single frame. You miss the whole, terrifying plot.

We noticed you haven't tried the Pattern Detection feature yet. This is the secret weapon. It's the difference between spotting a red flag and seeing the entire parade of them. The AI connects dots across multiple conversations you scan. It shows you the cycle, the escalation, the script they're following. It turns gut feelings into undeniable evidence.

Open the app right now. Don't just scan your latest text. Go to your dashboard and look for 'View Detected Patterns.' See what story your conversations are telling when they're read together. P.S. The users who catch toxic cycles early? They're the ones who message me months later saying it saved them from a world of hurt.
